notes: Today & tomorrow: up to 3 things a day, with the coming weekend’s Saturday and Sunday underneath
Setup is clearer for a new family: an overview of the steps, every click spelled out, its own licence key step, and a warning if it’s opened on a phone
The licence email explains exactly what to do and opens setup with the key already in it
The screen’s “Add your licence key” page lets you type the key in on the screen itself

Every app shows which family it’s connected to and can be disconnected: Family Calendar (⚙ next to Today), Family Admin (Settings → Devices → This phone), the screen (Status page), the setup app and the home page
Connecting a screen from a phone now says whose dashboard it will show and asks “Is this screen in your home?” – with “No – it’s someone else’s screen” leading to their own setup
